LESSON: COORDINATES AND GRAPHS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 4.2: Coordinates and graphs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Coordinates and graphs, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we plot coordinates on a Cartesian plane? 2. How do we use linear graphs in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. draw or trace and appropriately label the axes on the Cartesian plane. Those with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task.

2. practice locating and plotting points on a Cartesian plane appropriately in purposive pairs or groups.

3. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and read coordinates of points on the Cartesian plane. And 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. draw or trace and appropriately label the axes on the Cartesian plane. Those with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task.
2. practice locating and plotting points on a Cartesian plane appropriately in purposive pairs or groups.
3. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and read coordinates of points on the Cartesian plane. And 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Coordinates and graphs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses and reads coordinates of points on the Cartesian plane.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner generates values in a table of the simultaneous linear equations.

• Digital literacy: as the learner learns and uses IT graphing tools to create linear graphs.
